sources.title: mlboydaisuke/Qwen3.5-0.8B-MTP-repro-LiteRT · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B converted to .litertlm with a verify signature, plus the checkpoint's own 1-layer MTP (multi-token prediction) head packed as the drafter section LiteRT-LM's speculative decoding consumes (tf_lite_mtp_drafter). Weights are dynamic-range int8 on the linears and embedding tables; cache length 4096; three draft tokens per round. Built with the open recipe in hf-to-litertlm/mtp ...
